description: The adjustable values of the validated system: alert lead times and the account lockout. Changed by QA only under an approved change request (URS-PLT-012, URS-PLT-013).

fields.label: Lot Expiry Alert
fields.description: Days before a lot with stock expires that Stores and QA are alerted (1 to 365).

fields.label: Supplier Certificate Alert
fields.description: Days before the certificate of a supplier's decision in force expires that QA and Purchase are alerted (1 to 365).

fields.label: Customer Licence Alert
fields.description: Days before a customer's verified licence expires that Sales and QA are alerted, unless a renewed licence is verified (1 to 365).

fields.label: Document Review Alert
fields.description: Days before a controlled document's review date that its owner and QA are alerted (1 to 365).

fields.label: Change Action Due Alert
fields.description: Days before a change request action is due that its owner is alerted (1 to 90).

fields.label: Effectiveness Check After
fields.description: Days after implementation that a new change request's effectiveness is checked by default (0 to 730).

fields.label: Wrong Passwords Before Lockout
fields.description: Consecutive wrong passwords, at login or when signing, that lock the account (3 to 10).

fields.label: Locked For (minutes)
fields.description: How long a locked account stays locked (5 to 1440).

fields.label: Minimum Password Strength
fields.description: How hard a password must be to guess: 3 strong, 4 very strong.

fields.label: Password Valid For (days)
fields.description: After this many days a person must set a new password at sign-in (30 to 365).

fields.label: Sign Out After Inactivity (minutes)
fields.description: A session left unused this long ends; the person signs in again (5 to 480).

fields.label: Quality Weight (%)
fields.description: How much of a supplier's monthly score is quality (lots released); the rest is delivery (0 to 100).

fields.label: Re-evaluation Below Score
fields.description: A monthly score below this makes the supplier due for QA's re-evaluation (50 to 100).

fields.label: Change Request
fields.description: The approved change request that lists Quality Settings, named for this change.

name: Quality Settings
